items.headline: Nick Poulos accounts for 3 TDs, including go-ahead score, to help Ohio edge Ball State 35-28
items.description: — Nick Poulos accounted for three touchdowns, including the go-ahead score with 1:16 remaining, as Ohio rallied in the fourth quarter to beat Ball State 35-28 on Tuesday night.

items.headline: Burch becomes 12th Buffalo player with 1,000 rushing yards in 28-7 win over Ball State
